messages:
Aisha Rahman: HelioBank security questionnaire is asking for hosted API "no logging / zero retention" for prompts+completions. Is this something we can offer?

Olga Petrov: For hosted: we can say no training + access controls, but we cant guarantee zero content at rest today. Private (VPC) is the clean path.

Camila Reyes: +1. Theyre treating it as gating. Ill steer them to Private if we cant do hosted exception.

Elliot Price: Im logging a support ticket so were consistent. (SUP-4821)

Alex Martinez: If anyone has a crisp "hosted retention window + whats stored" blurb, please drop it here so we dont wing it on the call.
